subject: Important Update: Changes to Payment Process
body: Dear valued customers, we are writing to inform you about some changes to our payment process. In order to improve efficiency and security, we will be transitioning to a new payment gateway starting next month. This change will ensure smoother transactions and better protection of your financial information. Please stay tuned for detailed instructions on how to update your payment details. Thank you for your cooperation and understanding. Sincerely, The Finance Team
